'''Fataleka''' is a [[Southeast Solomonic languages|Southeast Solomonic]] language of [[Malaita]].

== External links ==
* Materials on Fataleka are included in the open access [[Arthur Capell]] collections ([http://catalog.paradisec.org.au/collections/AC1 AC1] and [http://catalog.paradisec.org.au/collections/AC2 AC2]) held by [[Paradisec]].
